titulo: At least 13 killed in Russian attacks on Ukraine as Poland investigates airspace violation – Europe live
cuerpo: Huge missile and drone attack on Ukraine as Poland’s Tusk prepares to travel to impact site discovered in east of country At least 13 people were killed and dozens injured in another night of heavy Russian attacks on Ukraine, with neighbouring Poland also investigating an reported airspace violation and explosion on its territory. Russia launched 74 missiles and 284 drones against targets in Ukraine, with casualties reported primarily in Dnipropetrovsk and Lviv regions. Continue reading...
